newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Ovoca secures option on Russian oilfields.
newsitem.headline: Ovoca secures option on Russian oilfields.

text.p: Ovoca Resources Plc said on Friday it had secured an option in respect of a 50 percent interest in four large oilfields located in the Uvat area of Western Siberia in Russia.
The oilfields are Gavrikovskoye, Travyanoye, Ust-Tegussskoye and Keumskoye, Ovoca said in a statement.

They have been assessed for Ovoca by Quad Engineering Limited, an independent petroleum engineering company, who concluded that the oilfields contained proven and probable reserves in excess of 500 million barrels.
Ovoca said it would issue 2.1 million ordinary shares of two pence each for the grant of the option.
Ovoca has the right to exercise the option at any time during the next six months but the option period can be extended with the agreement of both parties.
If the option is exercised, Ovoca will be obliged to issue 37 million ordinary shares of two pence each to the vendors, the company said.
